<solar/>Burning Maul becomes a single high-damage slam that creates five Cyclones of flame.

<solar/>Consecration's second slam creates a Cyclone of Flame.

Cyclones of Flame last ? seconds, deal continuous damage, and seek out targets.

<solar/>Burning Maul's Heavy Attack Slam deals 650% increased damage and releases 3 Waves, each of which creates a Cyclone on impact. Burning Maul ends after a single Slam.

<solar/>Consecration's second slam creates a Cyclone.

Cyclones track enemies (Burning Maul Cyclones move faster). Damage from multiple Cyclones stacks.

Waves apply 20 (60 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes equipped) <solar/>Scorch on impact. The released Cyclones deal <pve 20 /> <pvp [?] /> damage every ? seconds, and apply 3 (5 with Ember of Ashes) Scorch every 0.56 seconds.

Damage from multiple Cyclones can overlap.
